translation.firstTime: Is this your first time here?
translation.infoInInstagram: To see who doesn't follow you, click the <bold>{{buttonText}}</bold> button.
translation.infoNotInInstagram: Instagram needs to be open in the background for the extension to work.
translation.onboardingStep1: Log in to Instagram in your browser
translation.onboardingStep2: Click the button below to scan your account
translation.onboardingStep3: See who doesn't follow you back and unfollow them
translation.scanningInfo: Keep the Instagram tab open. You can close this panel; the scan continues as long as that tab stays open.
translation.scanRateLimit: Instagram asked us to slow down. Waiting about {{seconds}}s. Keep that tab open; closing this panel does not stop the scan.
translation.notConnected: Could not connect to Instagram. Please close the extension, refresh Instagram, and try again.
translation.noUnfollowersMessage: You don't have any friends who are not following you back.
translation.authError: You need to log in to Instagram or you don't have permission. Please log in to Instagram and try again.
translation.rateLimitWarning: Please wait {{seconds}} seconds before unfollowing another account
translation.actionBlocked: Instagram temporarily blocked this action. Please wait a few hours and try again.
translation.accountChanged: Your Instagram account changed, so the old list was cleared. Refresh to scan this account.
translation.unfollowAllDescription: This will unfollow {{count}} accounts. You can stop anytime, but it can't be undone.
translation.scanIncomplete: Instagram stopped the check early, so some accounts couldn't be verified and were left out of the list. Refresh later to check them again.
translation.settingsDescription: Slower settings make Instagram less likely to limit or block your account.
translation.scanSpeedBalancedHint: A few times slower, with short rests.
translation.scanSpeedCarefulHint: Slowest. For large accounts or after a limit.
translation.unfollowSelectedDescription: This unfollows {{count}} accounts slowly. You can stop anytime, but it can't be undone.
translation.unfollowPacingNote: {{min}}–{{max}} sec between each, with a {{rest}} min rest after every {{every}}.
translation.bulkResting: Resting {{time}} so Instagram doesn't flag the account
translation.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
translation.hiddenNote: Hidden accounts are never unfollowed in bulk.
translation.resumeWaiting: You can continue in {{time}}. Requests sent sooner would only be refused.
translation.resumeHint: Continue from where it stopped instead of starting again.
translation.tabHiddenHint: Keep the Instagram tab in front. Chrome slows down background tabs.
translation.exportOpenHint: Sends nothing to Instagram, so there is no risk of a block.
translation.exportIntro: Instagram lets you download your followers and following lists. Unfolks compares them on this computer; the file is never uploaded.
translation.exportStep1: Open Download your information in Accounts Center
translation.exportStep2: Choose only “Followers and following”, format JSON, then create the file
translation.exportStep3: When Instagram's email arrives, download the zip and drop it here
translation.exportDrop: Drop the zip or JSON files here
translation.exportNone: Everyone you follow follows you back.
translation.exportNote: Accounts from the file can't be unfollowed here. Open the profile, or scan to unfollow from the list.
translation.exportError_notZip: That file is not a zip. Drop the zip Instagram sent you, or the JSON files inside it.
translation.exportError_zip64: This zip is too large to read. Request the data again with only “Followers and following” selected.
translation.exportError_badZip: The zip looks damaged. Download it again from Instagram.
translation.exportError_encrypted: The zip is password protected. Unzip it and drop the JSON files instead.
translation.exportError_unsupportedCompression: The zip uses an unsupported format. Unzip it and drop the JSON files instead.
translation.exportError_noFollowers: No followers file found. Make sure “Followers and following” was included.
translation.exportError_noFollowing: No following file found. Make sure “Followers and following” was included.
translation.exportError_parse: A followers or following file could not be read. Request the data in JSON format and try again.
translation.exportError_unknown: The files could not be read.
translation.bulkStoppedFailures: Unfollowing stopped after several failures in a row. Wait a while, then try again.
